Remark
[the Riemann model of constant curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0155 ↗ def:pet-ch4-conformal-change For $\psi ^2\big((dx^1)^2+\dots +(dx^n)^2\big)$ to have constant curvature $k$, taking $\psi =\big(1+\tfrac k4r^2\big)^{-1}$ (with $\psi \cdot dx^1,\dots ,\psi \cdot dx^n$ the orthonormal coframe and $\psi ^{-1}\partial _1,\dots ,\psi ^{-1}\partial _n$ the orthonormal frame used in the Koszul-formula computation of $R$) gives the Riemann model, defined on all of $\mathbb {R}^n$ if $k\ge 0$ and on $B(0,2/\sqrt{|k|})$ if $k<0$.
